title: Electrostatic self-assembly synthesized Fe-MOF/g-C3N4 S-scheme heterojunction for enhanced photocatalytic pollutant degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28870-28880
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04928H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hongqiang Xin, Jingpu Zhang, Zeming Lin, Wen Li, Fei Ma
The Fe-MOF/g-C3N4 heterostructure exhibits excellent photocatalytic degradation performance, derived from more photo-generated electrons and holes in the S-scheme structure, boosting its redox ability leading to a highly photocatalytic performance.
